message.content:
An illustration for the cover of "TEMPO" magazine features a central, large red container resembling an oil drum with a Pertamina logo at the bottom. The drum is open, and its interior is a dark brown circular void. A cartoon woman with reddish-brown hair and glasses stands on a wooden plank extending over the opening. She wears a tan, patterned dress and has her hands behind her back, positioned as if being forced off a diving board. A rifle barrel is visible, pointing toward her from the right edge.

Text on the cover includes “KAREN OH KAREN” in large, red-orange capital letters. Below it, smaller white text reads: “MANTAN DIREKTUR UTAMA PERTAMINA KAREN AGUSTIAWAN MENJADI TERSANGKA KASUS PEMBELIAN LADANG MINYAK DI AUSTRALIA. KORUPSI ATAU KRIMINALISASI?”

At the top, three headlines appear: “KEPALA DAERAH PENDUKUNG JOKOWI”, “PALU SAYANG, PALU BERGUNCANG”, and “DETIK-DETIK AKUISISI FREEPORT”. The bottom-left corner includes the date “1-7 OKTOBER 2018,” the price “RP 45.000,” a barcode, and the magazine's website. The background is a muted greenish-brown.
